query: SELECT p.email FROM password p LEFT JOIN usr m ON m.workspace_id = $1 AND m.email = p.email WHERE p.super_admin AND NOT p.disabled AND (m.email IS NOT NULL AND NOT m.disabled OR m.email IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usr c WHERE c.workspace_id = $1 AND c.username = COALESCE(p.username, p.email))) ORDER BY m.email IS NULL, p.email LIMIT 1
